struck: Horry County's tax records code 1,268 parcels with a building as two-, three- or four-family buildings: 984 duplexes, 103 triplexes and 181 fourplexes, about 3,000 homes in all.
use: Horry County's tax records put about 1,270 parcels with a building under the land-use codes we read as two-, three- and four-family buildings, about 3,000 homes in all.

struck: About three in four of the county's duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes stand within a mile of the ocean.
use: Nearly 3 in 4 of the county's duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes stand within a mile of the ocean, measured in a straight line.

struck: About three in four stand within a mile of the ocean, and about a third within a quarter mile.
use: More than a third stand within a quarter mile of the ocean, measured in a straight line.

struck: In the inland groups it is about $230,000 to $255,000 (Windtree Estates, Tarpon Bay II, A Place at the River in Little River).
use: In three groups away from the old beach blocks it is about $230,000 to $255,000: Windtree Estates in Myrtle Beach, about 0.7 mile from the ocean; A Place at the River in Little River, about 2.7 miles; and Tarpon Bay II near Forestbrook, about 5 miles.

struck: In the inland groups the share is higher: 23 of 49 at Windtree Estates and 20 of 75 at Tarpon Bay II, against 9 of 113 in Cherry Grove Beach.
use: The share is lowest in North Myrtle Beach's old beach blocks (9 of 113 in Cherry Grove Beach, 4 of 42 in Ingram Beach) and highest at Windtree Estates (23 of 49), Ocean Terrace (20 of 54) and Tarpon Bay II (20 of 75).

struck: A 2-bedroom unit in a building of 2 to 4 units in Horry County rents for about $1,000 a month in lease rent.
use: In most of Horry County, a 2-bedroom unit in a building of 2 to 4 units rents for about $1,000 a month in lease rent, on leases of every age.

struck: FHA asks the same smallest down payment on a duplex or fourplex you live in as on a one-unit home.
use: When every buyer on the loan will live there, FHA asks the same smallest down payment on a duplex or fourplex as on a one-unit home. A co-borrower who will not live in a 2 to 4 unit building means a larger down payment.

struck: Freddie Mac's top loan on a duplex or fourplex you live in matches its top loan on a one-unit home, when its system accepts the loan.
use: On Freddie Mac's standard loans, the top loan on a duplex or fourplex you live in matches its top loan on a one-unit home, when its system accepts the loan; some of its low down payment programs allow more on a one-unit home only.

struck: DSCR means the loan qualifies on the property's rent, not your tax returns.
use: The lender qualifies the loan on the rent, not on your income.

struck: Two 2-bedroom units at about $1,000 each bring in about $24,000 a year, about 4.7 percent of the price before any costs.
use: (cut it: the rent is the Census median for rented units, mostly year-round leases, and the price is the county median, half of it beach buildings; the two groups differ)

struck: Per home, that duplex costs about $256,000, against about $350,000 for a resale house and about $215,000 for a resale condo.
use: Per home, that duplex costs about $256,000, against about $350,000 for a resold house or other home and about $215,000 for a resold condo in the same 12 months.

struck: No city or county in South Carolina may cap rents.
use: South Carolina does not let a city or county limit rents on privately owned homes.

struck: After that, you can move out, rent your old unit, and keep the whole building.
use: (cut it: no source; the handbook says only that one buyer must intend to live there at least a year)

struck: Because you live there, you can use an owner-occupied loan like FHA on a two-to-four-unit building: a far smaller down payment than an investor loan, and a lower rate.
use: (cut it: a rate comparison is a rate claim)
